user_question: Calculate total population and land area by census tract across Centre County.

workflow_plan.goal: Calculate total population and land area by census tract across Centre County.

workflow_steps.title: Join population attributes to census tracts
workflow_steps.purpose: Attach the supplied tract-level population records to the known census tract geometries.
workflow_steps.instructions: Perform an attribute join between the census tract vector and the supplied population table. Leave vector_key and table_key unset; runtime QC must ground the compatible tract identifier fields from observed schemas. Preserve one record per census tract and retain the population attribute.

workflow_steps.title: Retrieve tract-level land-area table
workflow_steps.purpose: Obtain a candidate tabular dataset containing land-area values by Centre County census tract.
workflow_steps.instructions: Retrieve a registered candidate table containing Centre County census tract land-area values with tract-level spatial coverage. Treat the returned dataset as a candidate; runtime QC must verify coverage, schema, tract identifier, and land-area field before joining.

workflow_steps.title: Join land area to population-enriched tracts
workflow_steps.purpose: Produce the final tract-level vector containing both population and land-area attributes.
workflow_steps.instructions: Join the retrieved land-area table to the population-enriched census tract vector. Leave vector_key and table_key unset; runtime QC must ground the compatible tract identifier fields and land-area field from observed schemas. Preserve one record per census tract and retain both population and land-area totals.

requirements.scope: The population attribute join must accept the known GeoPackage vector and CSV table inputs.

The retrieved land-area table must provide records for Centre County census tracts.

requirements.scope: The land-area attribute join must accept the population-enriched GeoPackage vector and retrieved CSV table.
The final join requires runtime-grounded tract identifier fields and a land-area field in the retrieved table, while retaining the population field from the prior join.

agent_profile_snapshot.name: Vector Analysis B
agent_profile_snapshot.description: Performs deterministic vector joins, dissolves, grouped aggregations, attribute joins, and buffering. Vector operations consume GeoPackage inputs. The service does not convert formats, repair invalid geometries, or reproject inputs automatically.

skills.name: Vector Aggregation and Joins
skills.description: Performs polygon dissolves, feature aggregations, spatial joins, attribute table joins, and spatial buffering on GeoPackage layers.

constraints.spatial: Requires matching coordinate reference systems for spatial joins. Requires projected CRS for metric buffer.
other: Accepts GeoPackage (.gpkg) vector format only. Rejects GeoJSON or Shapefiles.
Accepts CSV tables for attribute join operations.

table_key.description: Field name in tabular dataset for attribute join.
